summary: At a 1440x900 desktop window the game frame's board filled a 640px column with no height bound, so the person's own seat with its actions ("Take back my side") and a watcher's "You're watching" notice fell below the window. The wide board-focus frame now bounds the board by the window height less the frame around it and the host bar (never under 320px, never over 640px); a game's opt-in square fit only narrows it further.
